title: Spirit Tree
subtitle: Test your understanding of Spirit Tree — Mt Meru, Black Rock, Hyperborea, the Emerald Palace, and the central axis of Gateway-10.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The petrified stump at the North Pole is what remains of a crystalline tree whose roots still meet cathedrals and ancient sites. The Emerald Palace was never destroyed. Notice which maps point south, and which frequency still sits above the ice.

questions.question: What is the primary planetary designation for the central mountain and energetic valve located at the North Pole?

options.label: A
options.text: Mt Meru names that mountain valve.
options.rationale: Mt Meru is the primary planetary designation for the central mountain and energetic valve at the North Pole.

options.label: B
options.text: Hyperborea names that mountain valve.
options.rationale: Hyperborea is the high-vibrational central landmass around the tree, while Mt Meru names the mountain valve.

options.label: C
options.text: Black Rock names that mountain valve.
options.rationale: Black Rock is the petrified core remnant, while Mt Meru is the primary planetary designation for the mountain valve.

options.label: D
options.text: Gateway-10 names that mountain valve.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the wider realm network, while Mt Meru is the primary planetary designation for the mountain valve.

questions.hint: Look for the name tied to the mountain valve, apart from the land around it.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT actually situated at the North Pole, where the Spirit Tree originally stood?

options.label: A
options.text: The Black Rock foundation standing at that polar center.
options.rationale: Black Rock is the petrified core remnant situated at the geographic North Pole.

options.label: B
options.text: The green-crystal Emerald Palace standing at that polar center.
options.rationale: The Emerald Palace stands on Black Rock at the North Pole, where the Spirit Tree originally stood.

options.label: C
options.text: The severed trunk's petrified stump standing at that polar center.
options.rationale: The petrified tree stump is what remains where the Spirit Tree originally stood at the North Pole.

options.label: D
options.text: Sky-ice research facilities standing at that polar center.
options.rationale: Every geographical detail presented as Antarctica is at the North Pole, with the sole exception of the sky-ice research facilities.

questions.hint: Look at the one geographical detail mainstream accounts did not move.

questions.question: What physical structure characterized the Spirit Tree prior to hostile intervention?

options.label: A
options.text: Cold-ice branches, frequency overlays, and a capped central trunk line.
options.rationale: The cold ice was a later dampener, while the original tree had crystalline leaves, trunk, and roots.

options.label: B
options.text: Crystalline leaves, a crystalline trunk, and expansive crystalline roots.
options.rationale: In its original state the tree possessed crystalline leaves, a crystalline trunk, and expansive crystalline roots.

options.label: C
options.text: Red Mercury veins, strange idol plates, and a cut central stone trunk.
options.rationale: Red Mercury and idols belong to later extraction, while the original tree had crystalline leaves, trunk, and roots.

options.label: D
options.text: Gold-idol foliage, heavy ULF blankets, and a dampened central trunk above the node.
options.rationale: Gold idols and ULF blankets came later, while the original tree had crystalline leaves, trunk, and roots.

questions.hint: Recall the body of the central entity before the trunk was cut.

questions.question: What physical feature currently marks the petrified core remnant of the Spirit Tree at the geographic North Pole?

options.label: A
options.text: Black Rock is that petrified core remnant.
options.rationale: Black Rock is the physical foundation and petrified core remnant of the original Spirit Tree at the geographic North Pole.

options.label: B
options.text: A Red Mercury trench is that petrified core remnant.
options.rationale: Red Mercury names a liquid-extraction process, while Black Rock is the petrified core remnant.

options.label: C
options.text: A sky-ice basin is that petrified core remnant.
options.rationale: Sky-ice research facilities are the Antarctic exception, while Black Rock is the petrified core remnant.

options.label: D
options.text: A gold idol plateau is that petrified core remnant.
options.rationale: Gold idols were erected around the site, while Black Rock is the petrified core remnant.

questions.hint: Look for the name of the foundation left after the trunk was severed.

questions.question: Why are parasitic forces incapable of damaging or entering the Emerald Palace?

options.label: A
options.text: Phasing technology shifted the palace into Realm-2 and off the physical plane.
options.rationale: Phasing technology severed the trunk, while the palace remained intact because its intrinsic core harmonic sits above parasitic weaponry.

options.label: B
options.text: Its intrinsic core harmonic vibrates many octaves above parasitic weaponry and attack.
options.rationale: The intrinsic core harmonic of these crystalline edifices vibrates many octaves above the physical range and destruction capabilities of parasitic weaponry.

options.label: C
options.text: Artificial cold ice was set around the palace as a shield against entry.
options.rationale: Parasites laid the ice to suppress emanations, while the palace stays immune because its intrinsic core harmonic sits above their weaponry.

options.label: D
options.text: Elemental gold around the palace reflects incoming weapons back outward.
options.rationale: Gold idols project low frequencies, while the palace stays immune because its intrinsic core harmonic sits above parasitic weaponry.

questions.hint: Consider what separates the palace's native vibration from parasitic weaponry.

questions.question: Which coalition worked alongside the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) to deactivate specific frequency overlays?

options.label: A
options.text: The White Hats joined that deactivation.
options.rationale: The Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA) and White Hats deliberately deactivated specific frequency overlays after securing control of the system.

options.label: B
options.text: The Red Mercury crews joined that deactivation.
options.rationale: Red Mercury names a hostile extraction process, while the White Hats deactivated specific frequency overlays with the GAA.

options.label: C
options.text: The Gateway operatives joined that deactivation.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the realm network, while the White Hats deactivated specific frequency overlays with the GAA.

options.label: D
options.text: The density-field crews joined that deactivation.
options.rationale: Third-density perception was the overlay itself, while the White Hats deactivated specific frequency overlays with the GAA.

questions.hint: Look for the ground coalition named with the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.

questions.question: Why were mixed AI manipulations and special effects media intentionally left in place during overlay deactivations?

options.label: A
options.text: To hold the artificial ice thickness steady over greater Hyperborea.
options.rationale: The ice is a frequency-dampening layer, while the media mix was left to prevent widespread shock.

options.label: B
options.text: To leave an element of doubt and prevent widespread shock.
options.rationale: The overlays were powered down so humanity could glimpse living reality, while an element of doubt was left through mixed AI manipulations and special effects media to prevent widespread shock.

options.label: C
options.text: To hide the Spirit Tree roots from the parasitic parties.
options.rationale: Parasites already cannot enter the site, while the media mix was left to prevent widespread shock.

options.label: D
options.text: To stop elemental gold from meeting the planetary ley lines.
options.rationale: Gold naturally meets the crystalline lattice, while the media mix was left to prevent widespread shock.

questions.hint: Think about the caution that accompanied the first public glimpse.

questions.question: What primary purpose did parasitic forces achieve by creating fields of gold statues near the central node?

options.label: A
options.text: They power the holographic broadcasts benevolent forces send across the enclosed realm.
options.rationale: Benevolent forces project those broadcasts from the central valve, while the idols blanket ultra-high frequency emanations.

options.label: B
options.text: They rebuild the severed crystalline trunk of the central tree at the pole.
options.rationale: The idols were built to blanket ultra-high frequency emanations, not to rebuild the severed trunk.

options.label: C
options.text: They steady third-density ice sheets across those far southern landmasses.
options.rationale: The idols sit at the central node to blanket ultra-high frequency emanations, not to steady southern ice.

options.label: D
options.text: They project ultra-low frequencies that blanket the node's ultra-high frequency emanations.
options.rationale: Parasites used satanic idolatry and heavy ultra-low frequencies (ULF) to damp and blanket the overwhelming ultra-high frequency (UHF) emanations from the central node.

questions.hint: Consider what those idols were built to do to the node's output.

questions.question: Which cultural reference was directly inspired by the Emerald Palace on Black Rock?

options.label: A
options.text: The Black Rock stump in polar voyage tales.
options.rationale: Black Rock is the petrified core, while the palace is the Emerald City in The Wizard of Oz.

options.label: B
options.text: The gold idol field in ceremonial statue tales.
options.rationale: The gold idols are parasitic dampeners, while the palace is the Emerald City in The Wizard of Oz.

options.label: C
options.text: The Emerald City in The Wizard of Oz story.
options.rationale: The Emerald Palace is immortalized in popular culture as the Emerald City in The Wizard of Oz.

options.label: D
options.text: The sky-ice station in expedition tales.
options.rationale: Sky-ice research facilities are the Antarctic exception, while the palace is the Emerald City in The Wizard of Oz.

questions.hint: Look at the popular story tied to the green crystal sanctuary.

questions.question: How did density suppression technology obscure the Emerald Palace from standard human sight?

options.label: A
options.text: By dropping physical perception to a 3rd-density observational simulation.
options.rationale: Heavy ULF blankets dropped the structure's physical perception down to a 3rd-density observational simulation while it remained intact at its native UHF vibration.

options.label: B
options.text: By moving the whole palace down into the buried root channels.
options.rationale: The palace remained on the surface, while ULF blankets dropped physical perception to a 3rd-density observational simulation.

options.label: C
options.text: By bending ambient light around the palace with a drifting Red Mercury mist.
options.rationale: Red Mercury names gold extraction, while ULF blankets dropped physical perception to a 3rd-density observational simulation.

options.label: D
options.text: By packing the green crystal deep inside the petrified stump.
options.rationale: The palace stayed on Black Rock, while ULF blankets dropped physical perception to a 3rd-density observational simulation.

questions.hint: Focus on what happened to human perception while the palace stayed intact.

questions.question: What is the true origin and function of the deep cold ice layer covering the North Pole?

options.label: A
options.text: It is an artificial physical frequency-dampener meant to suppress emanations and deter travel.
options.rationale: Parasites blanketed the North Pole in deep artificial cold ice that operates as a physical frequency-dampener designed to deter human travel.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a natural climatic sheet formed over the polar land by ordinary weather.
options.rationale: The ice does not stem from natural climatic conditions; it operates as a physical frequency-dampener.

options.label: C
options.text: It is runoff frozen from the severed crystalline trunk and its scattered leaves.
options.rationale: The ice is a projected frequency-dampener, not runoff from the severed trunk.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a protective shield the Galactic Ancestral Alliance laid across the pole.
options.rationale: Hostile entities laid the ice as a frequency-dampener, while the GAA works to disable overlays.

questions.hint: Separate a projected cover from a climatic one.

questions.question: What process did parasites use to extract gold from the earth for constructing idol fields?

options.label: A
options.text: Liquid-extraction processes similar to Red Mercury.
options.rationale: Parasites used liquid-extraction processes similar to Red Mercury to pull gold from the earth and erect idol fields.

options.label: B
options.text: Trunk-cutting passes made with hostile phasing technology.
options.rationale: Phasing technology severed the trunk, while gold was pulled by liquid-extraction processes similar to Red Mercury.

options.label: C
options.text: Thermal blasts driven by the heavy ULF generators.
options.rationale: ULF fields came from the idols after they were built, while gold was pulled by liquid-extraction processes similar to Red Mercury.

options.label: D
options.text: Condensation grids tied to density suppression.
options.rationale: Density suppression altered perception, while gold was pulled by liquid-extraction processes similar to Red Mercury.

questions.hint: Look at how elemental gold was pulled out of the ground.

questions.question: What technological operation do benevolent forces perform from the central hub at Mt Meru?

options.label: A
options.text: They still draw Red Mercury upward to reinforce the buried ley lines.
options.rationale: Red Mercury names hostile extraction, while benevolent forces project high-dimensional holographic broadcasts from the hub.

options.label: B
options.text: They maintain the artificial ice that hides ancient artifacts scattered on the pole.
options.rationale: Parasites laid that ice, while benevolent forces project high-dimensional holographic broadcasts from the hub.

options.label: C
options.text: They generate low-frequency blankets that isolate the connected realms.
options.rationale: Low-frequency blankets are parasitic, while benevolent forces project high-dimensional holographic broadcasts from the hub.

options.label: D
options.text: They project high-dimensional holographic broadcasts across the enclosed realm.
options.rationale: From this central hub, benevolent forces project high-dimensional holographic broadcasts across the entire realm enclosed within the ice wall.

questions.hint: Think about what is sent outward from that geographic placement.

questions.question: True or False: Removing the central tree mechanism severely restricted available energy across all 178 realms of Gateway-10.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Removing the central tree mechanism severely restricted available energy across all 178 realms of Gateway-10.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The severance did restrict available energy across all 178 realms of Gateway-10.

questions.hint: Look at how far the loss of the central mechanism reached.

questions.question: True or False: The known lands surrounding the Spirit Tree were formerly designated Gateway-10.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the whole network, while the known lands were formerly Realm-2.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree occupies the absolute center of the known lands (formerly Realm-2), while Gateway-10 is the wider network.

questions.hint: Separate the old name of the known lands from the name of the whole network.

questions.question: What component of the Spirit Tree structure survived the hostile attack and remains embedded worldwide?

options.label: A
options.text: The subterranean crystalline roots under cathedrals and ancient sites.
options.rationale: The underlying subterranean crystalline roots and nodal junction points remain embedded and interface with every major cathedral, temple, and ancient site worldwide.

options.label: B
options.text: The solid gold core pillars set beneath the nearby idol fields.
options.rationale: Gold was extracted for idols, while the subterranean crystalline roots remain embedded worldwide.

options.label: C
options.text: The sky-ice branch networks spread under the southern research stations.
options.rationale: Sky-ice facilities are the Antarctic exception, while the subterranean crystalline roots remain embedded worldwide.

options.label: D
options.text: The petrified crystalline leaves left from the lost upper canopy.
options.rationale: The primary trunk was lost, while the subterranean crystalline roots remain embedded worldwide.

questions.hint: Consider which buried part still meets cathedrals, temples, and ancient sites.

questions.question: What dual tactical purpose did hostiles achieve by severing the main trunk of the Spirit Tree?

options.label: A
options.text: It destroyed the Emerald Palace outright and dissolved the buried crystalline root networks.
options.rationale: The palace and the subterranean roots remained, while the severance restricted energy and lowered ambient frequencies.

options.label: B
options.text: It restricted realm energy and lowered ambient frequencies so parasitic species could set foot on the land.
options.rationale: The attack prevented resident species from accessing sufficient power to mount a counter-offensive and reduced Hyperborea's ambient frequencies so parasitic species could set foot on the land.

options.label: C
options.text: It collapsed the surrounding ice wall and shifted the polar land into the southern oceans.
options.rationale: The attack restricted energy and lowered ambient frequencies so parasitic species could set foot on the land, rather than moving the pole.

options.label: D
options.text: It turned the planetary ley lines into open channels for liquid Red Mercury extraction.
options.rationale: Red Mercury names gold extraction, while the severance restricted energy and lowered ambient frequencies so parasites could set foot on the land.

questions.hint: Think about both the power left to residents and the frequency left on the land.

questions.question: What term defines the high-vibrational central landmass that surrounds the central tree structure?

options.label: A
options.text: Mt Meru is that surrounding land.
options.rationale: Mt Meru is the central mountain and energetic valve, while Hyperborea is the landmass around the tree.

options.label: B
options.text: Black Rock is that surrounding land.
options.rationale: Black Rock is the petrified core remnant, while Hyperborea is the landmass around the tree.

options.label: C
options.text: Hyperborea is that central land.
options.rationale: Hyperborea is the high-vibrational central landmass surrounding the central tree structure at the heart of the known world.

options.label: D
options.text: Gateway-10 is that surrounding land.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the full realm network, while Hyperborea is the central landmass around the tree.

questions.hint: Look at the name of the land that rings the central tree.

questions.question: How does elemental gold interact with the realm grid when operating in its uncorrupted state?

options.label: A
options.text: It throws ultra-low frequency blankets across the organic light emanations of the node.
options.rationale: Low-frequency blankets come from the idols, while uncorrupted gold regulates electromagnetic structures in the lattice.

options.label: B
options.text: It meets the crystalline lattice network and regulates electromagnetic structures.
options.rationale: Elemental gold naturally interacts with the crystalline lattice network to regulate electromagnetic structures.

options.label: C
options.text: It hardens the artificial ice that shields the buried root channels below.
options.rationale: The ice is a frequency-dampener, while uncorrupted gold regulates electromagnetic structures in the lattice.

options.label: D
options.text: It cuts crystalline roots away from the secondary nodal junction points.
options.rationale: The roots stay linked to nodal junction points, while uncorrupted gold regulates electromagnetic structures in the lattice.

questions.hint: Consider gold's role in the lattice before it was pulled up and cast as idols.

questions.question: How did the destruction of the main trunk at Hyperborea impact the broader Gateway-10 system?

options.label: A
options.text: It dropped the Emerald Palace's native vibration into 3rd density.
options.rationale: The palace kept its native UHF vibration, while the trunk's loss created a systemic energy bottleneck.

options.label: B
options.text: It created a systemic energy bottleneck across the gateway network.
options.rationale: The destruction of the main tree at Hyperborea created a systemic energy bottleneck across the entire gateway network.

options.label: C
options.text: It cut the crystalline roots of the spirit trees in other realms.
options.rationale: Other realms retained their central spirit trees, while the main trunk's loss created a systemic energy bottleneck.

options.label: D
options.text: It shut down holographic broadcast technology at the central valve.
options.rationale: Benevolent forces still project broadcasts from the hub, while the trunk's loss created a systemic energy bottleneck.

questions.hint: Reflect on what a damaged central hub does to power across linked realms.

questions.question: Which structures on the physical plane remain continuously linked to the subterranean root system?

options.label: A
options.text: The density suppression towers raised over old Realm-2.
options.rationale: Suppression fields work against the grid, while the roots interface with every major cathedral, temple, and ancient site worldwide.

options.label: B
options.text: Every major cathedral, temple, and ancient site worldwide.
options.rationale: The subterranean crystalline roots continue to interface with every major cathedral, temple, and ancient site worldwide.

options.label: C
options.text: The sky-ice research facilities stationed far off in Antarctica.
options.rationale: Those facilities are the Antarctic exception, while the roots interface with every major cathedral, temple, and ancient site worldwide.

options.label: D
options.text: The fields of gold idols erected near the North Pole.
options.rationale: The idols dampen the node, while the roots interface with every major cathedral, temple, and ancient site worldwide.

questions.hint: Think about sacred buildings and ancient sites spread across the world.

questions.question: True or False: The foundational organic crystalline architecture at the exact central axis of the realm is the Spirit Tree.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the foundational organic crystalline architecture situated at the exact central axis of the realm.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: That central architecture is the Spirit Tree, the foundational organic crystalline architecture on the axis.

questions.hint: Look at the name of the architecture that sits on that axis.

questions.question: What outcome will occur across the global lattice membrane network when the central valve at Mt Meru is fully unlocked?

options.label: A
options.text: The 178 connected realms split apart into isolated sectors across the whole gateway.
options.rationale: Unlocking the valve restores flow across the global lattice membrane network and realm homeostasis, rather than isolating the realms.

options.label: B
options.text: Parasitic entities still gain a lasting entry into the buried crystalline root grid.
options.rationale: Restored high frequency is what parasitic species cannot endure, while the valve restores flow across the global lattice membrane network.

options.label: C
options.text: Full ultra-high frequency flow returns across the global lattice membrane network and realm homeostasis.
options.rationale: Unlocking the central valve at Mt Meru restores full ultra-high frequency flow across the global lattice membrane network and re-establishes natural realm homeostasis.

options.label: D
options.text: The Emerald Palace dissolves downward into a sheet of third-density observational ice.
options.rationale: Unlocking the valve restores flow across the global lattice membrane network rather than dissolving the palace.

questions.hint: Consider what returns to the buried root system once that valve opens.

questions.question: True or False: The native operational state of the Spirit Tree and the Emerald Palace is ultra-low frequency.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Ultra-low frequencies are the parasitic dampener, while the edifices radiate ultra-high frequency emanations.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The central node radiates overwhelming ultra-high frequency (UHF) emanations, while ultra-low frequencies were the parasitic blanket.

questions.hint: Separate the site's own output from the frequencies parasites projected onto it.

questions.question: Why are artificial ULF dampening fields around the central site ultimately ineffective in the long term?

options.label: A
options.text: Mainstream media narratives periodically reset the public density overlays across the pole.
options.rationale: Media inverted geography, while the fields fail because the harmonic vibrates far above parasitic weapons.

options.label: B
options.text: The artificial cold ice dissolves ULF output as soon as the two fields meet.
options.rationale: The ice works with the dampening, while the fields fail because the harmonic vibrates far above parasitic weapons.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasites lose the ability to pull elemental gold after long seasons of use.
options.rationale: The fields fail because the harmonic vibrates far above parasitic weapons, not because gold extraction runs out.

options.label: D
options.text: The core harmonic vibrates far above parasitic weapons, so those fields stay temporary.
options.rationale: The fundamental harmonic vibrates far above the reach of parasitic weapons, so artificial ULF dampening fields are inherently temporary and fail to alter the permanent crystalline architecture.

questions.hint: Recall why low-vibrational weaponry cannot rewrite the crystalline edifices.
